title: The Retroid Pocket Duo Lite Plus might be the Goldilocks dual-screen handheld
summary: The Pocket Duo Lite Plus might strike the best balance between performance, features, and price.
body: Credit: Retroid TL;DR Retroid has announced the Pocket Duo Lite Plus dual-screen handheld. This model is similar to the Pocket Duo Lite but offers the Pocket Duo’s chipset and base RAM/storage. The Pocket Duo Lite Plus has a discounted launch price of $199. Retroid announced the Retroid Pocket Duo and Pocket Duo Lite last week, the latest entry in the increasingly crowded dual-screen handheld space. The standard Pocket Duo is the more upmarket option, while the Lite version makes a few compromises for the price. Does neither option work for you? Then Retroid has now revealed the Pocket Duo Lite Plus. The Retroid Pocket Duo Lite Plus is effectively a middle ground between the Pocket Duo and Pocket Duo Lite. Perhaps the most notable change is the switch from the Lite’s QCS6125 chipset to the standard model’s Q-7790 processor. In other words, you’re effectively going from a low-end Snapdragon 665 chip to a more modern Snapdragon 7 Gen 4.
